title: MMAD: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Industrial Anomaly Detection
verification: Codex independently opened primary paper section 4.3 after consultant research
supported_summary: Normal image templates did not consistently improve the evaluated MLLMs. The paper also compares randomly supplied and nearest normal templates. This motivates a controlled test and does not establish improvement on IPAD or the present video protocol.
scope: Other numerical claims or papers in the consultant's broad research response were not adopted as verified facts. Only this short checked research summary is used in the experiment rationale.
